relationships.subject: nimodipine

relationships.subject: AMPA receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that the synaptic transmission in the ACC was mediated by glutamate AMPA/kainate receptors.

key_findings: TBS induced L-LTP lasting 5 h in tree shrew ACC, larger than in mice, and weak TBS also induced LTP.
Tree shrew ACC LTP depends on NMDA receptors, L-type Ca2+ channels and AC1.
